summary.en-US: Unofficial companion for Inha University in Tashkent students: a cleaner eClass with your timetable, deadlines, attendance, scores, INS grades and university mail in one place.

description.en-US:
**Unofficial.** Made by an IUT student, not by the university.

IUT for eClass gives eClass (eclass.inha.ac.kr) a clean, readable look, light or dark, and puts what you check every day where you already are:

- **Today:** your next class and room, or exam, and what's due soon.
- **Course list:** absences, VODs watched, your eClass score and what's due next, beside every course.
- **Deadlines** across all your courses, with reminders before they close.
- **Attendance** against each course's limit.
- **Scores** from eClass's own grade report, with what-if numbers for marks still open, and your **INS grades**.
- **University mail:** read, search, write, reply and attach files.
- **Schedule** from the public timetable, and the **exam timetable**.

It needs your own IUT accounts (eClass, and optionally INS and university mail). It talks only to the university's services, as you; nothing goes to the developer or anyone else. Saved passwords are encrypted in your browser.

Privacy policy: https://github.com/kamol1dn/inha_app/blob/main/extension/PRIVACY.md

Source code: https://github.com/kamol1dn/inha_app

version.approval_notes:
Unofficial companion for students of Inha University in Tashkent. Everything it shows needs a student's own university account: eClass (eclass.inha.ac.kr), and optionally INS (ins.inha.uz) and university mail (mail.inha.uz, Exchange Web Services). These are personal accounts the university issues to its students, so we can't provide a test account; the developer can't share their own. Without an account the extension shows its sign-in prompts and settings only.

Network: only those three university hosts plus iut.edupage.org (the public timetable, no login). No server of its own, no analytics. Saved passwords are encrypted with AES-GCM under a non-extractable WebCrypto key in the extension's IndexedDB (src/core/vault.ts) and posted only to their own service's login form.

The innerHTML warnings come from bundled libraries (Preact, and linkedom in the background script for parsing fetched pages), not from our code: src/ has no innerHTML.

Build (the attached source archive, also https://github.com/kamol1dn/inha_app under extension/): Node 24, then
  cd extension
  npm ci
  IUT_VERSION=<this version> npm run build:firefox
The add-on is dist-firefox/. esbuild bundles and minifies TypeScript and Preact; nothing is obfuscated. The build also reads ../assets/exams/ (the exam timetable as JSON), which the archive includes.
